newsitem.title: USA: Solucorp says unit receives $15 mln pact.
newsitem.headline: Solucorp says unit receives $15 mln pact.

text.p: Solucorp Industries Ltd said Tuesday that its British licensee, John Beach Ltd, has received a $15 million subcontract to use its technology in cleaning up a site contaminated by heavy metals.
It is part of a $150 million contract recently awarded to Bullen Consultants of Britain by the government of Portugal for the design, remediation and construction of a site.
Treatment of several different waste streams with its technology, known as MBS, to establish treatment standards is to begin by mid-November in advance of a full-scale cleanup in April, it said.
The company said the contract is valued at about $15 million gross revenues, resulting in $1 million royalty plus an estimated $1.5 million in profits.
